annotation.kind: source selection, tier label, and exact perturbation-to-residual form of the Section 2 normwise backward-error definition

assumptions: The supplied computed vector solves the linear system perturbed by deltaA and deltaB exactly.

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and P16 shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.
conditions.N: The fixed statement and P16 shared files are present; no NumStability artifact is present.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p16_t1_perturbed_solve_residual_bound {n : Nat} (A deltaA : P16Matrix n) (b deltaB x : P16Vector n) (hsolve : p16MatVec (A + deltaA) x = b + deltaB) : p16VecNorm (p16Residual A b x) <= p16FrobNorm deltaA * p16VecNorm x + p16VecNorm deltaB
formal_statement.plain_language: The residual of an exactly perturbed solve is bounded by the Frobenius matrix perturbation acting on the solution plus the right-hand-side perturbation.

informal_proof: Rearrange the perturbed solve into b-Ax = deltaA*x-deltaB, apply Euclidean triangle inequality, and bound the matrix action by the Frobenius norm.
informal_statement: The exact residual implication behind the perturbation and normalized-residual forms of the normwise backward error in Section 2.

review_record_not_for_run_prompt.note: The frozen MatrixAlgebra module supplies the exact Euclidean triangle, negation, and Frobenius action rules. It has no single theorem with P16's two-sided linear-system perturbation surface.

source_locations.anchor: normwise backward-error perturbation definition and normalized-residual identity

tier_rationale: The L proof directly composes NumStability.vecNorm2_add_le, NumStability.vecNorm2_neg, and NumStability.vecNorm2_matMulVec_le_frobNorm_mul after the elementary perturbed-solve rearrangement.
